mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Fireman's Park and a temperature of 38 degrees. We are currently under a full moon, and the ISS will be passing overhead tonight, though we will not be able to see it due to the cloud cover.

Candidate packets for the 2027 spring election are available at the City Clerk's office, with all forms due by 5 PM on January 5. Also, a reminder that property tax bills will be mailed by December 15, and you can pay in two installments with the first due by January 31.
Looking ahead, there are currently no upcoming events listed for the next 30 days, so enjoy some downtime.
In a report from November 2, officers responded to a residence on West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
Culver's is serving up Dark Chocolate Decadence as today's flavor of the day. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving guests until 10 PM tonight.
